summary: This component displays a collapsible list of blog posts that belong to the same series. It fetches all blog metadata, filters to only posts matching the given series name, sorts them chronologically, and renders them as links — except for the current post, which is shown as plain text and optionally highlighted to indicate you're already reading it.

explanations.44: getBlogMetadata() returns all blog posts; we chain filter and sort to get only posts in this series, ordered by date.
explanations.46: We convert the date strings to timestamps so we can numerically compare which post came first.
explanations.48: If there are no posts in this series, we return null instead of rendering an empty list, which keeps the page cleaner.
explanations.56: The 'values' object lets us inject the series link into the translation string as a dynamic placeholder named {seriesLink}.
explanations.68: We check if this post's permalink matches the one we were told to exclude (the current post), which tells us whether to link it or just display the title.
explanations.74: clsx combines multiple CSS class names conditionally — we always apply currentPost, and additionally apply currentPostDimmed only if highlightCurrent is true.
